fields.description: Portal login user (Website User) that will access the Vendor Dashboard for this site.
fields.label: Vendor User

fields.description: While off, the captive portal shows a maintenance message instead of the STK push flow. Voucher redemption and Lipa Namba are unaffected.
fields.label: Enable Online Payment (Mobile Money)

fields.description: Shows a one-time free-trial button on the captive portal. Each device (by MAC address) can only claim it once per site -- claiming again is blocked automatically once used.
fields.label: Enable Free Trial

fields.description: How long a first-time device gets connected for free before it's disconnected. The device's MAC is then registered so it cannot claim the free trial again.
fields.label: Free Trial Duration (Minutes)

fields.description: Every week from Friday 18:00 to Saturday 18:00 the portal stops sales (mobile money, Lipa Namba, vouchers) and shows a Sabbath message. Connected devices keep their remaining time.
fields.label: Enable Sabbath Mode (Fri 18:00 – Sat 18:00)

fields.description: Set up on the central Omada Controller from Hotspot Omada Settings. Use the Omada > Create on Omada button.
fields.label: Omada Provisioning

fields.description: Open Wi-Fi network customers join; the captive portal handles payment.
fields.label: Hotspot SSID Name

fields.description: Once a client is authorized on the Omada controller, the portal page redirects the browser here to break it out of the captive portal.
fields.label: Success Redirect URL

fields.description: Every TP-Link AP that serves this site's captive portal. Adopting an AP from the Omada menu adds it here.
fields.label: Access Points

fields.description: Shown in place of the default WiFi mark on this site's captive portal. Also editable live from the mobile app's Customize Portal screen.
fields.label: Portal Logo

fields.description: Overrides the default "Premium WiFi Access" line on the captive portal. Leave blank to keep the default (translated EN/SW).
fields.label: Portal Tagline

fields.description: QR / till-number picture shown when a customer taps Lipa Namba on the portal.
fields.label: Lipa Namba Image
